steps.narration: By the end of this tutorial, you will be able to read your Harness pipelines and edit one without leaving Velox. To start, open Deployment tab from the left rail.

beats.caption: Open Deployment Module from the left rail

steps.narration: Deployment opens on two flows. Click on DevOps here first, which houses your Harness lifecycle end-to-end
DevOps opens on the overview, where every pipeline's health and the runs that finished most recently are already on screen.
Open Settings first to confirm which Harness account you are looking at. Velox names the organization and project it is bound to.

beats.caption: Open Settings from the DevOps rail
The organization and project in scope

steps.narration: The token itself lives on your profile, under integrations, so it is set once and does not come up again.

beats.caption: Token set once on your profile

steps.narration: Open Pipelines to see everything Harness holds for this project, each one carrying the status of its last run.

beats.caption: Every pipeline listed with its last status

steps.narration: Select a pipeline and its definition opens as YAML, with an in-line editor on one side and an AI edit panel on the other.
Edit it here as you would in Harness. Nothing changes on the platform until you press Save to Harness.

beats.caption: Edits reach Harness only on save

steps.narration: If you would rather describe the change than write it, the panel beside the editor takes it in plain words.

beats.caption: Describe a change in plain words

steps.narration: The same pipeline carries two more views worth knowing about. Triggers shows what fires it, and whether that is switched on.

beats.caption: Triggers show what fires the pipeline

steps.narration: Input sets hold the values a run is given, and opening one shows which stages it feeds.

beats.caption: Saved inputs a run is given
Expanded to the stages it feeds

steps.narration: Deployments answers what actually ran, with each execution's number, duration and outcome, filtered to the dates you care about.

Any row opens its execution, broken down stage by stage, with how it was triggered and who started it. 
Velox brings every Harness pipeline into the same place as the rest of your work.

variants.note: Baseline. Tutorials carry no hook or CTA.
